title: partition_owner state record body
description: Which host owns one partition of a team. The host serves the agents placed in the partition, and its NATS credential names the partition; its signed sequence is the fencing token, as a placement's is.

host_epoch.description: The membership epoch of the host's certificate when it was given the partition. Renewals do not move the partition: a reader accepts the record while the host's liveness record names a certificate of that runtime at this epoch or later.
